title: Vampire Vape Purple Craze Ice 10ml E-Liquid
description: Vampire Vape’s Purple Craze Ice freebase e-liquid builds on the iconic fusion of Heisenberg and Pinkman, with an added menthol kick for a cooler, more refreshing vape. The intense blend of ripe red berries and mixed fruits from Pinkman meets Heisenberg’s signature menthol breeze and aniseed spice, amplified for an even frostier sensation. This flavour is ideal for vapers who crave fruity flavours with a deeply satisfying, bracing icy finish. Purple Craze Ice delivers a bold, fruity and icy vape that perfectly balances sweetness with a cool menthol punch. With a 60VG/40PG or 50VG/50PG ratio depending on nicotine strength, Purple Craze Ice ensures rich flavour and vapour production, making it perfect for use in starter kits, MTL setups, and sub-ohm devices (low-strength versions only.) Purple Craze Ice freebase e-liquid is available in the following nicotine strengths: 0mg (60/40) – Nicotine-free 3mg (50/50) – A low nicotine option 6mg (60/40) – A mild nicotine hit 12mg (60/40) – A medium-strength vape 18mg (60/40) – A stronger, more potent nicotine experience Whether you prefer a nicotine-free experience or powerful nicotine relief, Purple Craze’s smooth and flavoursome freebase formulation caters to every type of vaper.
